description: Length-matched helix-axis curvature of the cytosolic helix in Yet1p, Yet2p, Yet3p and the BAP29/BAP31 crystal and predicted models
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def ca_from_pdb(txt, chain=None):
    out={}
    for L in txt.split('\n'):
        if L.startswith('ATOM') and L[12:16].strip()=='CA' and L[16] in ' A':
            if chain and L[21]!=chain: continue
            out[int(L[22:26])]=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
    return out
S={}
for nm,acc in {'Yet1':'P35723','Yet2':'Q04210','Yet3':'Q07451','BAP29':'Q9UHQ4','BAP31':'P51572'}.items():
    m=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=60).json()[0]
    S[nm]=ca_from_pdb(requests.get(m['pdbUrl'],timeout=60).text)
S['BAP31_4JZP']=ca_from_pdb(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4JZP.pdb",timeout=60).text,chain='A')
S['BAP29_4W7Y']=ca_from_pdb(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4W7Y.pdb",timeout=60).text,chain='A')
SPAN={'BAP31_4JZP':(169,219),'BAP29_4W7Y':(165,215),'BAP31':(168,220),'BAP29':(164,216),
      'Yet1':(142,183),'Yet3':(150,191),'Yet2':(128,158)}
W=31
def axis(P):
    A=np.linalg.svd(P-P.mean(0),full_matrices=False)[2][0]
    return A if np.dot(P[-1]-P[0],A)>0 else -A
def metrics(ca,lo,hi):
    idx=[i for i in range(lo,hi+1) if i in ca]; P=np.array([ca[i] for i in idx]); n=len(P)
    a1,a2=axis(P[:n//3]),axis(P[-(n//3):])
    bd=np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(np.dot(a1,a2),-1,1)))
    ax=np.array([P[max(0,k-3):k+4].mean(0) for k in range(n)])[3:-3]
    c=ax.mean(0); A=axis(ax); d=ax-c
    return bd, float(np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm(d-np.outer(d@A,A),axis=1)**2).mean()))
rows=[]
for nm,(lo,hi) in SPAN.items():
    idx=[i for i in range(lo,hi+1) if i in S[nm]]
    wins=[(idx[k],idx[k+W-1]) for k in range(0,len(idx)-W+1)]
    M=[metrics(S[nm],*w) for w in wins]; b=[m[0] for m in M]; r=[m[1] for m in M]
    rows.append({'protein':nm,'helix_len':len(idx),'n_win':len(wins),
                 'bend_deg':round(float(np.median(b)),1),
                 'axis_rmsd_A':round(float(np.median(r)),3),'axis_rmsd_max':round(float(np.max(r)),3)})
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('axis_rmsd_A',ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
print(f"Helix-axis curvature, length-matched {W}-residue windows\n")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
g=lambda n,c: float(df.loc[df.protein==n,c].iloc[0])
cmin=min(g(n,'axis_rmsd_A') for n in ['BAP31_4JZP','BAP29_4W7Y','BAP31','BAP29'])
print(f"\nYet2p 0.113 A vs straightest BAP29/BAP31 model {cmin:.3f} A: {cmin/g('Yet2','axis_rmsd_A'):.1f}x straighter")
print(f"Yet2p vs the 4JZP crystal dimer chain A: {g('BAP31_4JZP','axis_rmsd_A')/g('Yet2','axis_rmsd_A'):.1f}x straighter")
print(f"Yet2p vs Yet1p: {g('Yet1','axis_rmsd_A')/g('Yet2','axis_rmsd_A'):.1f}x straighter")
print("\nCaveat: Yet2p's helix yields only 1 window (31 res), so it has no spread, and an")
print("isolated short helix in an AlphaFold monomer model is prone to an idealised straight form.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.7))
col={'BAP31_4JZP':'k','BAP29_4W7Y':'0.5','BAP31':'tab:blue','BAP29':'tab:cyan',
     'Yet1':'tab:green','Yet3':'tab:orange','Yet2':'tab:red'}
y=np.arange(len(df))[::-1]
ax[0].barh(y,df.axis_rmsd_A,xerr=[np.zeros(len(df)),df.axis_rmsd_max-df.axis_rmsd_A],
           color=[col[n] for n in df.protein],height=.62,error_kw=dict(lw=1,ecolor='0.3'))
for k in range(len(df)): ax[0].text(df.axis_rmsd_A[k]+.06,y[k],f"{df.axis_rmsd_A[k]:.2f}",va='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax[0].axvspan(0.32,0.65,color='tab:blue',alpha=.10)
ax[0].text(0.49,len(df)-0.4,'BAP29/BAP31\nrange',ha='center',fontsize=7.5,color='tab:blue')
ax[0].set_yticks(y); ax[0].set_yticklabels(df.protein,fontsize=9); ax[0].set_xlim(0,6.6)
ax[0].set_xlabel('helix-axis RMSD from a straight line (A)')
ax[0].set_title(f'Supercoil bow, median of {W}-residue windows')
ax[1].barh(y,df.bend_deg,color=[col[n] for n in df.protein],height=.62)
for k in range(len(df)): ax[1].text(df.bend_deg[k]+2,y[k],f"{df.bend_deg[k]:.0f}",va='center',fontsize=8.5)
ax[1].set_yticks(y); ax[1].set_yticklabels([]); ax[1].set_xlim(0,185)
ax[1].set_xlabel('bend angle, first third vs last third (degrees)'); ax[1].set_title('Helix bend')
plt.suptitle('Yet2p cytosolic helix 128-158 is straight; the BAP29 and BAP31 dimer helices bow',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
